Integration inventory for #319 at 0f1059ba; inspected all five premise dossiers and existing typed theorems. See docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md, Integration reuse audit. Existing PowerExistenceBoundary already proves both omission models and the support-to-transmission conditional; duplicating them is rejected. FirstMoverSimple and GodIsSimple already derive their conditional simplicity conclusions. #495 excludes incoming existential support from present sources but does not relate that relation to q3 uniting causes or proper components. A candidate interface would map a distinct CausesIn c x esse witness to support at a world where c exists, for the same x; neither source presence nor this semantic correspondence follows from the existing types. NecessaryPerSeIsMaximeEns identifies n with each given maximum; it does not furnish a maximum. De re NecessaryAt and temporal IsNecessaryPerSe remain unmapped. PSR reason tokens do not supply external supporters or identify their bearer with the power source. #591 separates consecutive motion respects and supplies no omitted power/esse bridge. No source attribution added, no new formal consequence claimed, and no root premise added or discharged; exact eight route costs retained: 31,32,36,38,39,39,40,41. Shared local service corpus record query succeeded at its separate pinned 75192b1c workspace; this was a read-only API check, not Lean verification.

BOUNDED TERTIA-CONVERGENCE SOURCE AUDIT (2026-11-01): Materialized/read full AQUINAS-ST-I-Q44-A1, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A4, AQUINAS-SCG-I-15-EN[1–7] and AQUINAS-DE-ENTE-C3-4[69874–69875]. Three narrow q44ad2/ad3 claims/independent bare statements plus source glossary added: necessity compatible with efficient cause; positive effect-would-not-be-without-cause rationale even for impossible terms; and mathematical abstraction in reason versus efficient causation qua esse. This is not cause⇒necessary-effect, material-implication vacuity or a universal esse-cause→cause-of-necessity theorem. Existing AQUINAS-SCG-I-15-FIRST-NECESSARY-IS-FIRST-CAUSE / STMT-FIRST-NECESSARY-THROUGH-ITSELF-IS-GOD-AS-FIRST-CAUSE retained without duplicate: it identifies first necessaryperse with God as firstcause after aliunde/perse fork and regress, not independent defense of both bridges. Reused AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A4-ESSE-ACTUALITY-OF-EVERY-FORM-A→STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING and AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A4-DISTINCT-ESSE-EXTERNAL-CAUSE→STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE; neither supplies necessity→InAct with arbitrary Possible/IsAt. NecessaryBeingHasBeing quantifies IsNecessary=not Possible(nonbeing) without actualguard or InAct dictionary; CauseOfNecessaryBeingCausesItsNecessity universally maps CausesIn at esse to distinct primitive CausesNecessityOf. Q44ad2 supports caused necessities and dependence but does not independently state that full universal map. DeEnte[69874] received esse in immaterial forms and [69875] received/limited esse do not equate bare modalNE with uncaused/perse. Q3a4ad2 distinguishes actus essendi from propositional composition, reinforcing dictionary caution. Existing TERTIA-VIA-NECESSARY-PER-SE-IS-MAXIME-ENS consumes maximum-genus principle+bothbridges+EM to identify EACH necessaryperse with EACH supplied maximum; it provides no maximum existence and not all necessary individuals areperse. Candidate retained/offroot per#180; no automatic migration, new Lean/pin/axiom/inference/model or premise truth/closure. These readings do not exhaust possible defenses. Focused corpus/source manifest-binding checks PASS (2724 statements,1885 claims,469 passages; existing unrelated Frege-Geach warning only), whitespace PASS. Claim/type self-sweep keeps independent identity, caused-necessity versus modal necessitation, impossible-counterfactual scope and abstraction qua esse without attributing the stronger universal dictionaries. No premise change or discharge. Coordinator independently read the complete materialized Latin q44a1 and allnine changed records; accepts narrowad2/ad3 readings with no fidelity findings. Root corrected the stale historical blocker sentence saying no new source investigation was authorized: this bounded audit was explicitly authorized and completed; substantive dictionary obligations remain open.
